title: 0-Code Sound Frames
tagline: Frames shoudnt only be developer friendly, even as a developer it is stressful to code and deploy a frame. My project allows you to make a frame in 15 seconds !
description:
This project allows artists or music lovers to share their favorite sound.xyz project on warp cast using frames. 

All you have to do is provide a link for the project and you are all set. The website not only creates meta tags but also hosts it for you so you don't have to! 

All you have to do is get the link and sit back, relax.
how_its_made:
Frame.js: The starting point of my project, converts everything to metadata.  It holds everything together, making sure our frames  dont fall apart.

Tailwind CSS: For UI obviously, saving us time. It makes sure everything looks stunning with minimal fuss. Think of it as putting on a tuxedo with a snap of your fingers.

Node.js: The engine room. It's what keeps our project running smoothly, handling all the heavy lifting without breaking a sweat.

Replit: Our project's cloud palace. Here, it lives and breathes, accessible from anywhere, without the usual landlord headaches.

Axios & Cheerio: The dynamic duo. They sneak around the web, grabbing pictures and artist data like secret agents on a mission.

Sound SDK: Our magical black box. It does things we'd love to talk about but then we'd have to say something cheeky like, "we'd tell you, but then we'd have to invent an NDA to joke about not telling you."  But jokes aside, just played around with it, nothing too major was used
